title: Robust LLM Alignment via Distributionally Robust Direct Preference Optimization

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating preference distribution shifts by training models on specific mixtures of reward objectives (e.g., emotion preferences skewed towards 'fear', or specific qualitative metrics like helpfulness) and evaluating them on out-of-distribution preference mixtures (e.g., skewed towards 'anger', or unseen metrics like honesty) to measure robustness against over-optimizing for the majority preferences present in the training data.
